props.name: media
props.description: Any node to reveal instead of an image.

props.name: word
props.description: Word cut out of the cover, for `type`.

props.name: scrollLength
props.description: Runway past the pinned frame, in view heights.

props.name: settle
props.description: Share of the runway after which the mask is fully open.

props.name: smooth
props.description: Seconds the reveal takes to catch up with the scroll. `0` follows it exactly.

props.name: feather
props.description: Edge softness, as a percentage of the frame.

props.name: stagger
props.description: 0–1. Delay spread across slats and cells.

props.name: originX
props.description: Where the reveal starts, in percent of the frame.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Scale the media starts at, settling to 1 as it opens.

props.name: overlay
props.description: 0–1. Dark scrim over the media, for legible children.

props.name: revealContent
props.description: Fade children in as the reveal completes.

props.name: inset
props.description: Holds the frame in from the edges of the view.
